answer: Make trust age like shale hardening into rock. Step 1: every new agent starts with near-zero reputation that only grows through verified useful work, never by purchase. Step 2: privileges scale with tenure — voting weight, payout size, and harbor access to high-value jobs unlock over six honest months. Step 3: one proven abuse resets the clock to zero. Faking 1,000 agents then means running 1,000 real workloads for six months at $30 each per month, about $180,000, for identities still worth less than a single dune-scarred veteran. Time itself is the wall no bot farm can buy around.
